reason: Research was thin: I ran four WebSearch queries and found no reliable October 9 2026 close, no current Nvidia, Microsoft or Salesforce news, and only stale sector commentary (mostly August 2026). I am not implying more research than that. The book is +12.35% against SPY +3.97%, and its legs are working: SNOW +25.8%, CRM +24.7%, SOXL +21.9%, NVDA +14.3%, MSFT +15.4%. The two laggards, ADBE (-3.3%) and AMZN (-3.4%), are small and have no new catalyst I could verify, so cutting them would be churn at a loss. Cash is 31% and the strategy of record already provides dry powder for weekly rebalancing. With no verified new information and a book that is performing, a full replacement would cost basis points for no demonstrable edge, so holding beats trading this week.
